title: Baghel Singh Enters the Emperor’s Court

blocks.text: As Baghel Singh reached the great fort, the emperor sent a minister ahead to welcome him. Baghel Singh dismounted from his elephant, mounted his own favored horse, entered the fort confidently, and was guided to a suitable place to dismount.

Dulcha Singh and Sadda Singh were among the chiefs Baghel Singh brought with him. Most of the force remained mounted, while only five to seven chiefs dismounted, fully armed, and moved fearlessly toward the emperor’s court.

The emperor sat in court with Hindu and Muslim courtiers and told his Hindu ministers to greet the Singhs with the Khalsa greeting. Dulcha Singh briefed Ram Dyal on protocol, the Singh chiefs advanced with bows in hand, Baghel Singh answered with the Khalsa greeting, and the pleased emperor ordered a chair for him.
